thread:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished for release v2.14.0 to prod (staggered: eu1 -> eu -> us). triggering post-deploy smoke suite now.

lucy: ack, I'll watch the synth dashboards for eu1.

kevin: seeing synth failures in eu1 embed probe: ~4% 503s over the last 3 minutes. p95 latency jumped to 2.4s.

sre-oncall: alerted by synth-alerts. initial scatter looks like spikes coincide with prefilling batch windows after warmstart.

maria: pasted quick tail of embed proxy logs:
```
2026-11-12T09:12:30Z eu1-embed-proxy INFO request id=aa12 status=200 lat=18ms
2026-11-12T09:12:41Z eu1-embed-proxy ERROR request id=bb34 status=503 upstream=encoder-42 msg="kvcache miss and OOM-retry"
2026-11-12T09:12:44Z eu1-embed-proxy ERROR request id=cc56 status=503 upstream=encoder-43 msg="model variant exhausted"
```

jen: run `k logs --since=5m svc/encoder-42 -n prod-eu1 | head` and paste if you can.

lucy: ran it, looks like transient OOMs during warmup. a few hosts hit memory high and restarted the worker, causing short 503 bursts.

kevin: breakdown from deploybot telemetry: canary rollout at 30% in eu1. error rate concentrated on hosts with quantized-encoders enabled.

maria: hypothesis: the new quantization profile in v2.14.0 is slightly more memory-hungry for long sequences; warmstart combined with batch fanout caused pressure.

lucy: proposal: pause further canary expansion, flip affected route to fallback model-variant `embed-small-v1` for eu1, and keep v2.14.0 pinned for current hosts. no full rollback yet.

jen: +1. we can toggle routing via the rollout API: `POST /rollouts/route-toggle { region: "eu1", route: "embeddings", variant: "embed-small-v1" }`

deploy-bot: Received command: pausing rollout expansion for v2.14.0. Applying route toggle for eu1 -> embed-small-v1. Will keep 30% canary pinned to existing hosts.

kevin: after toggling at 09:15 UTC, error rate dropped back to baseline within two probe cycles. p95 latency improved to 180ms.

sre-oncall: good—keeping hold on expansion. action items:
- kevin to collect heap profiles from encoder hosts hit by OOM (kevin)
- maria to run automated model memory regression test against long-sequence prompts (maria)
- lucy to prepare brief rollout note for #eng-releases and product (lucy)
- jen to schedule a 30-min postmortem sync if root cause points to quantization profile change (jen)

lucy: I'm drafting release note: "Hold expansion of v2.14.0; enabled fallback variant in eu1 after transient embed probe errors during warmstart. Investigating quantization memory delta." Will post once finalized.

maria: running memory regression now, will paste results in thread.

kevin: copying logs and profiles to s3://redwood-debug/3599999999/

jen: thanks all. leaving the hold window in place until we have regression verdict or decide to rollback. tagging this as `hold-expanded-rollout` and `investigating`.

lucy: :thumbsup: closing monitoring loop for now — will keep the thread updated.

sre-oncall: marking incident ticket INF-2026-762 as low-sev. update in 2h or on new findings.

deploy-bot: Note: automatic rollback threshold remains enabled. will execute rollback if error rate > 5% sustained for 5 minutes."
